about: The DigiDestined and other Digimon Tamers as special trainers (designed by the user): who they are, their sprite, the Pokémon (species) that always leads their team, and in Multi Battles who partners them. Teams are in digidestined.txt. 'weight': their weight in the special-trainer pool (the Gym Leaders are 7). 'name': their name when the section title (their key in the data, for lines) differs, as 'Henry (Tamer)' (the game has a Gentleman Henry). 'legend': true makes them a Battle Legend instead (Takato, Henry): they then appear where battle-50-trainers.json puts them, at its weights, and have no weight or partners here. 'partners': in a Multi Battle they always battle alongside one of these (picked with equal chance), who goes first (shown on the left); a partner can be a Battle Legend (Tai), another trainer listed here, or any other special trainer (Izzy's Colress and Cheren). After editing either file, run: npm run data:custom
